create.name: Cyndi Dale
create.bio:
Based in Minnesota, Cyndi Dale is an American author, teacher and intuitive energy healer. After studying English and philosophy she undertook master's-level study in divinity at Bethel University, and she has trained in Therapeutic Touch, shamanism, intuitive healing and the Lakota Way. Across several decades she has worked one to one with tens of thousands of clients in private intuitive sessions and given workshops in the Americas, Europe, Africa and China.

The subtle body is at the heart of her teaching: an expanded system of twelve chakras, the auric fields, kundalini and the energetic boundaries that lie between people. Her more than 40 books have appeared in some 20 languages; among them Energetic Boundaries, Llewellyn's Complete Book of Chakras and The Subtle Body, her encyclopedia of energetic anatomy. She offers self-paced video courses on The Shift Network as well as her own online classes, audio programmes and small in-person retreats, combining clear explanation with guided meditation and practical exercises for working with energy and developing intuition.

books.title: The Subtle Body: An Encyclopedia of Your Energetic Anatomy
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: An illustrated reference to the human energy system, drawing together chakras, meridians, auras and other subtle-energy models from traditions around the world. It is widely used by energy workers as a desk reference.

books.title: Llewellyn's Complete Book of Chakras
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: A large guide to the chakras and related energy systems, covering their history across cultures, how each centre is described, and practical exercises for working with them.

books.title: The Complete Book of Chakra Healing: Activate the Transformative Power of Your Energy Centers
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: An expanded edition of her earlier New Chakra Healing, setting out her twelve-chakra system with its energy bodies and spiritual points, and techniques for working with each centre.

books.title: Energetic Boundaries: How to Stay Protected and Connected in Work, Love, and Life
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: Explains the idea of energetic boundaries around body, mind and spirit, and offers practical exercises for keeping them clear while staying open in relationships and at work.

books.title: Kundalini: Divine Energy, Divine Life
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: An overview of kundalini energy as described in several spiritual traditions, with guidance on understanding a kundalini awakening and working with it safely.

books.title: The Intuition Guidebook: How to Safely and Wisely Use Your Sixth Sense
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: A practical guide to developing intuition, describing different kinds of intuitive ability and giving steps for using each with care and discernment.

books.title: Awaken Clairvoyant Energy
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: A short book from her Essential Energy Library on clairvoyance: how visual intuition works, and exercises for developing it in everyday life.

books.title: The Subtle Body Practice Manual: A Comprehensive Guide to Energy Healing
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: A hands-on companion to The Subtle Body, turning the reference material into step-by-step techniques for practitioners working with the energy system.

books.title: Illuminating the Afterlife: Your Soul's Journey Through the Worlds Beyond
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: Describes her picture of the soul's journey after death through twelve spiritual planes, and what this can mean for how we live now.

books.title: Beyond Soul Mates: Open Yourself to Higher Love Through the Energy of Attraction
books.author: Cyndi Dale
books.description: Looks at love and attraction through the lens of energy and karma, with practices for opening to healthier, more conscious partnerships.

courses.title: Activate Your Clairvoyant Powers
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on clairvoyance. Cyndi explains the different kinds of 'clear seeing' and how each relates to a chakra in her twelve-chakra model, with meditations and practices.

courses.title: Quantum Energy Healing
courses.description: A twelve-module self-paced video course that builds on her clairvoyance training with a set of quantum and chakra-based energy tools, guided meditations and demonstrations. It includes the seven-module introductory programme.

courses.title: Radical Energy Healing
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on what Cyndi calls the Divine Pathway, with energy practices for calling in guidance, clearing blocks and initiating change.

courses.title: Advanced Radical Energy Medicine
courses.description: A twelve-module self-paced video course in which students build a personal energy medicine toolkit using the extrasensory gifts of the chakras. It includes the seven-module introductory programme.

courses.title: Dreaming Through the Dark: A Retreat with Cyndi Dale
courses.description: A two-day in-person retreat for up to 30 people in Hillsborough, North Carolina, presenting her newest teaching on the quantum field and the ninth to twelfth chakras. Sessions mix teaching, meditation and group practice, with meals and audio recordings included.

courses.title: Shamanic Empowerment Through the Chakras
courses.description: A recorded online class that journeys through the chakras into the lower, middle and upper worlds of shamanic tradition, with a focus on the eighth chakra and soul gifts.

courses.title: New and Unusual Chakras
courses.description: A three-part recorded series on lesser-known energy centres and practical ways to work with them alongside the classic chakras.

courses.title: Three Types of Kundalini
courses.description: A video teaching on three distinct forms of kundalini energy, with three guided meditations for experiencing each one gently.

courses.title: 12 Chakra Audio Guided Meditation Series
courses.description: An audio series that moves through all twelve chakras in her system, describing each centre and guiding a meditation to connect with its gifts.

courses.title: Meet "The Clairs" — Three Sisters of Intuition
courses.description: Three pre-recorded classes of about two and a half hours each on clairvoyance, clairaudience and clairsentience, forming a foundation course in intuitive development.

Email support@cyndi-dale.com is the team's support address (Cloudflare-encoded on the Two-Hour Sessions and Subtle Body Immersion pages); appointments@cyndidale.com also appears on the One-on-One page.

Her Shift course sales pages (Quantum Energy Healing, Advanced Radical Energy Medicine) make heavy health claims (pain, migraines, anxiety, depression); the titles are clean so they are kept with neutral descriptions of our own — check you are happy with that.
Shift prices for Activate Your Clairvoyant Powers and Radical Energy Healing are a sale price ($297, regular $347).

Three of her own offerings (Three Types of Kundalini, 12 Chakra series, The Clairs, New and Unusual Chakras) only have checkout/offer URLs from her Learn page; those links return a Cloudflare check to curl, so they could not be opened, though they were mapped to titles from the page HTML.
Her own YouTube channel has low views (all under 1,000); several of her most-viewed videos were left out for trauma/anxiety titles.
